meta.scenario: Single-junction solar cell under standard sunlight (ASTM G173 AM1.5G, 1000 W/m2, 25 C)

status_legend.measured: a number reported in the cited source
status_legend.geometry: follows from the shape alone, no data needed
status_legend.calibration: a fit parameter, set so the model reproduces a cited benchmark
status_legend.estimate: our own assumption, not taken from a source; say so on the slide. Each one is varied in the sensitivity check

meta.cost_unit: USD per m2 of module, on the basis of NREL's 2020 minimum sustainable price (MSP). Not current market prices.
meta.inspiration: Irvin et al., Solar RRL 10, e70360 (2026) inspired the project. No design, value or geometry in this file is taken from it.

bit_layout.order: material(2 bits) | geometry(2 bits) | passivation(2 bits), most significant bit first

spectrum.source: ASTM G173-03 global tilt spectrum, 280-4000 nm, 2002 points, integrates to 1000.37 W/m2 (copied from the pvlib package data)

sources.bandgap_eV: measured: 1.12 eV ('Efficiency Limits in Photovoltaics: Case of Single Junction Solar Cells', Facta Universitatis Ser. Electron. Energ., Table 1)
sources.thickness_um: measured: 160 um wafers on the industry roadmap (NREL/TP-7A40-78173, Sec. 3.1.2; 180 um was standard in 2020)
sources.absorption: measured: Green & Keevers, Prog. Photovolt. 3, 189 (1995), tabulated at pveducation.org; see silicon_absorption below
sources.tau_bulk_s: estimate: 1 ms. Kotipalli et al. measured 3.8 ms on float-zone wafers; solar-grade Cz wafers are lower
sources.D_cm2_per_s: estimate: minority-electron diffusivity in p-type Si, about 30 cm2/s
sources.S_bare_cm_per_s: measured: about 1e5 cm/s for bare low-resistivity Si (Maeckel & Cuevas, Proc. 3rd WCPEC, 71, 2003). It falls with resistivity, so this is the pessimistic end
sources.S_best_cm_per_s: measured: 3 cm/s with plasma-ALD Al2O3 (Kotipalli et al., EPJ Photovolt. 4, 45107, 2013, Table 3)
sources.degradation_pct_per_year: measured: median 0.5 %/year over about 2000 field rates (Jordan & Kurtz, Prog. Photovolt. 21, 12, 2013)
sources.max_process_temp_C: measured: thermal oxide is grown on Si at 1050 C (Kotipalli 2013)
sources.record_efficiency: measured: 27.81 % (LONGi back-contact cell, Solar Cell Efficiency Tables v66, reported by pv magazine 2026)
sources.reference_geometry: the record cell is pyramid-textured and fully passivated, so the model is calibrated on pyramids + Al2O3
sources.base_cost_usd_m2: calibration: NREL MSP of 0.25 USD/W x 200 W/m2 (400 W on a 72-cell module of about 2 m2) = 50 USD/m2 for a pyramid-textured, Al2O3-passivated PERC module. Minus the 0.6 and 1.5 USD/m2 step costs below, so that c-Si / pyramids / Al2O3 comes out at 50

sources.bandgap_eV: estimate: textbook value for CdTe, 1.45 eV
sources.thickness_um: estimate: 2 um. 1 um of CdTe already absorbs more than 92 % (EPFL thin-film PV lecture notes)
sources.absorption: calibration: direct-gap law alpha = alpha0 * sqrt(E - Eg), with alpha0 set so 1 um of CdTe absorbs 92 % of the above-gap photons in one pass
sources.tau_bulk_s: estimate: 50 ns. Upper bound is 360 ns measured in single-crystal CdTe (IEEE J. Photovolt. 5, 366, 2015; NREL/JA-5J00-62303)
sources.S_bare_cm_per_s: measured: untreated CdTe exceeds 1e5 cm/s (IEEE J. Photovolt. 5, 382, 2015)
sources.S_best_cm_per_s: measured: reduced by an order of magnitude to about 1e4 cm/s (IEEE J. Photovolt. 5, 366, 2015)
sources.degradation_pct_per_year: measured: 0.5 %/year warranted for First Solar Series 6 (NREL/TP-7A40-78173, Sec. 3.2)
sources.max_process_temp_C: estimate: tolerates a 300 C deposition, not a 1050 C furnace
sources.base_cost_usd_m2: measured: NREL MSP of 0.28 USD/W x 174 W/m2 (430 W on 2.47 m2) = 48.7 USD/m2

sources.thickness_um: measured: 1.5 um absorber in NREL's CIGS cost model (NREL/TP-7A40-78173, Table 6)
sources.absorption: estimate: same direct-gap alpha0 as calibrated for CdTe
sources.tau_bulk_s: measured: 250 ns bulk lifetime in a double-graded absorber (Weiss et al., Sci. Technol. Adv. Mater. 20, 313, 2019)
sources.S_bare_cm_per_s: estimate: taken equal to untreated CdTe
sources.degradation_pct_per_year: estimate: between the low CIGS rates in recent studies and the roughly 1 %/year typical of thin films (Jordan et al., 'Compendium of photovoltaic degradation rates', Prog. Photovolt. 2016)
sources.max_process_temp_C: estimate: tolerates a 300 C deposition, not a 1050 C furnace
sources.record_efficiency: measured: 23.64 % certified by Fraunhofer ISE (Uppsala University / First Solar European Technology Center, 2024)
sources.base_cost_usd_m2: measured: NREL MSP of 0.48 USD/W x 160 W/m2 (16 % module) = 76.8 USD/m2

sources.bandgap_eV: measured: 1.5-1.6 eV for methylammonium lead iodide (NREL/TP-7A40-78173, Sec. 4.2)
sources.thickness_um: measured: 200-500 nm layers absorb across the visible (NREL/TP-7A40-78173, Sec. 4.2)
sources.absorption: estimate: direct-gap law with alpha0 2.5 times the CdTe value, so that a 0.5 um film absorbs about as much as 1 um of CdTe. Consistent with 200-500 nm layers absorbing across the visible (NREL/TP-7A40-78173)
sources.D_cm2_per_s: estimate: chosen with tau_bulk to give a diffusion length in the um range, as NREL/TP-7A40-78173 reports
sources.degradation_pct_per_year: estimate: 3 %/year. No 25-year field data exists. Published outdoor results run from 2.83 % lost over three years (Nanoscale Adv. 2025, doi:10.1039/d5na00622h) to 22 % lost in the first year (imec, 2025)
sources.max_process_temp_C: measured: Al2O3 ALD at 125 C significantly degrades MAPbI3; 75 C is best (Nanoscale Adv. 2021, doi:10.1039/d1na00075f)
sources.record_efficiency: measured: 28.0 % on a 0.05 cm2 cell (Solar Cell Efficiency Tables v68). Modules reach only 19.3-22.1 %
sources.base_cost_usd_m2: measured: NREL MSP estimate of 0.38 USD/W x 160 W/m2 (16 % module) = 60.8 USD/m2, at small production scale

sources.reflectance: measured: 3.67 % AM1.5G-weighted for an optimised planar two-layer coating ('Front side antireflection concepts for silicon solar cells with diffractive rear side structures', Fraunhofer ISE, 2014)
sources.path_enhancement: geometry: two passes with a rear mirror

sources.reflectance: measured: 1.8 % weighted average for random pyramids with a SiNx coating (Nawabjan et al., TELKOMNIKA 16(4))
sources.cost_usd_m2: estimate: wet alkaline etch. NREL puts the whole PERC cell conversion at 0.049 USD/W, about 11 USD/m2

sources.reflectance: measured: 1.21 % weighted for needle-like black silicon ('Front side antireflection concepts for silicon solar cells with diffractive rear side structures', Fraunhofer ISE, 2014), applied here to both sub-wavelength textures
sources.path_enhancement: measured: up to 73 (Garnett & Yang, 'Light Trapping in Silicon Nanowire Solar Cells', Nano Lett., 2010). This is their best case
sources.area_factor: measured: nanowires 4 um tall and 400 nm wide have 2000 % more area than a flat surface (Jeong, McGehee & Cui, Nat. Commun. 4, 2950, 2013)
sources.cost_usd_m2: estimate: masking plus a deep etch

sources.reflectance: measured: 1.21 % weighted for black silicon ('Front side antireflection concepts for silicon solar cells with diffractive rear side structures', Fraunhofer ISE, 2014), applied here to both sub-wavelength textures
sources.area_factor: measured: cones 400 nm tall on a 450 nm base have only 67 % more area than a flat surface (Jeong, McGehee & Cui 2013)
sources.cost_usd_m2: estimate: masking plus a shallow etch

sources.process_temp_C: measured: grown at 1050 C (Kotipalli et al. 2013)
sources.conformality: geometry: the oxide grows out of the silicon itself, so it follows any shape
sources.cost_usd_m2: estimate: a high-temperature furnace step, which Kotipalli et al. note raises processing cost

sources.process_temp_C: measured: deposited at 300 C (Kotipalli et al. 2013)
sources.conformality: estimate: fraction of the textured surface actually coated, in geometry order. PECVD is directional: full coverage on flat and pyramids (the industry standard), 95 % on shallow cones, 70 % on 4 um wires

sources.S_on_cSi_cm_per_s: measured: 3 cm/s for plasma ALD, 17 cm/s for thermal ALD (Kotipalli et al. 2013, Table 3)
sources.process_temp_C: measured: ALD runs at 250 C on Si (Kotipalli 2013) and down to 75 C on perovskite (Nanoscale Adv. 2021). The model uses the lowest available temperature
sources.conformality: measured: a conformal ALD alumina film solved surface recombination on black silicon (Savin et al., Nat. Nanotechnol. 2015, doi:10.1038/nnano.2015.89; below 7 cm/s in von Gastrow et al., Sol. Energy Mater. Sol. Cells)

direct_gap_absorption.source: calibration: 1 um of CdTe absorbs more than 92 % (EPFL thin-film PV lecture notes)

silicon_absorption.source: measured: Green & Keevers, Prog. Photovolt. 3, 189 (1995), every 50 nm from the table at pveducation.org; interpolated log-linearly
